page.overview:
Who is Willie Haines?

On the way, Willie stopped by a vending machine to grab a snack as he had missed his dinner, while Franklin went on ahead. Seconds later, Willie heard Franklin scream and went to find out what happened. He heard a loud noise bumping around in the washing machine and turned it off. He saw the clothes covered in blood and the loud object was Franklin's head. Willie fell back from shock and discovered Franklin's headless body. Michael appeared behind him and slit his throat with a Kitchen knife.
